title: Outlook for Mac: Purview Data Loss Prevention for calendar events
summary: Hold: the Outlook policy-tip path skips opening or creating a policy configuration and reaching its settings, so administrators cannot follow it directly to the switch. The roadmap facts and PowerShell call are supported; calendar-specific defaults and implementation details remain unpublished, while general DLP licensing is documented.

claims.claim: Learn documents email DLP policy tips for Outlook for Android, iOS and macOS.
claims.quote: Outlook for Android, iOS, and macOS now supports data loss prevention (DLP) policy tips with commonly used predicates and exceptions, advanced classifiers, and override capabilities.
claims.fix: Add after the email-support statement: 'Microsoft's troubleshooting article still says policy tips are not supported for Outlook for Mac iOS clients, conflicting with this dedicated reference.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/troubleshoot/microsoft-365/purview/data-loss-prevention/data-loss-prevention-policy-tips#client-doesn't-support-mailtips.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: Email Policy Tip UI is off by default in Outlook for Android, iOS and macOS.
claims.quote: Policy Tip UI is turned off by default in Outlook for Android, iOS, and macOS to allow for administrators to test and perform user training prior to deployment.

claims.claim: Administrators enable the documented email Policy Tip UI through the named policy in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.
claims.quote: To enable Policy Tip UI to appear in Outlook for Android, iOS, and macOS, you must enable the policy listed in the following section in the Microsoft 365 Apps Admin Center.

claims.claim: Customization > Policy Management > Enable Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policy tips in Outlook is a direct route to the control in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.
claims.quote: On the Policy configurations page, select Create. ... On the Configure Settings page, select the policies that you want to include in the policy configuration.
claims.fix: Replace the path in both locations with 'Customization > Policy Management > Create > Configure Settings > Enable Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policy tips in Outlook'. Add https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365-apps/admin-center/overview-cloud-policy to sources and note: 'When creating a configuration, enter its name and choose the user or group scope before Configure Settings.' Keep the existing policy-tip docs link, which supplies the final setting name.

claims.claim: The email policy-tip setting can be targeted to individuals or groups.
claims.quote: You can target policies to individuals or groups, so you can test and deploy policy tip UI as needed through your organization.

claims.claim: Learn documents no API or automation operation for the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center policy-tip switch.
claims.quote: Searched: "Enable Purview Data Loss Prevention" "policy tips" API PowerShell; Cloud Policy service Microsoft 365 Apps admin center Microsoft Graph API PowerShell configure policies. Read Cloud Policy overview and mobile tip reference; returned Exchange tip APIs do not set this switch.

claims.claim: Solutions > Data Loss Prevention > Policies > + Create policy opens DLP policy creation in the Microsoft Purview portal.

claims.claim: New-DlpCompliancePolicy -Name <policy name> -ExchangeLocation All -Mode <PolicyMode> creates an email DLP policy with the specified state.
claims.quote: Use the New-DlpCompliancePolicy cmdlet to create data loss prevention (DLP) policies ... The Mode parameter specifies the action and notification level of the DLP policy. ... Type: PolicyMode

claims.claim: New-DlpCompliancePolicy runs in Security & Compliance PowerShell.
claims.quote: This cmdlet is available only in Security & Compliance PowerShell.

claims.claim: The ExchangeLocation parameter accepts All rather than a mailbox list.
claims.quote: The ExchangeLocation parameter specifies whether to include email messages in the DLP policy. The valid value for this parameter is All.

claims.claim: The printed call includes email for all users.
claims.quote: If you use -ExchangeLocation All by itself, the policy applies to email for all users.

claims.claim: The general DLP policy control is not confirmed to govern calendar events in Outlook for Mac.
claims.quote: Searched: "Outlook for Mac" "calendar" "DLP" default policy enforcement actions. Read New-DlpCompliancePolicy ExchangeLocation, deployment scope, email policy-creation walkthrough and roadmap description; none specifies how Exchange email policy scope includes Mac calendar events.

claims.claim: General DLP deployment controls include policy scope.
claims.quote: Every policy is scoped to one or more locations, such as Exchange, SharePoint in Microsoft 365, Teams, and Devices. ... You can further refine which instances of the location ... that the policy is applied to by configuring the include/exclude options

claims.where: Governance controls; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: General DLP policy states include simulation, simulation with policy tips, full enforcement and off.
claims.quote: Run the policy in simulation mode ... Run the policy in simulation mode and show policy tips while in simulation mode ... Turn it on right away: This is full enforcement mode. ... Keep it off: The policy is inactive.

claims.where: Governance controls; Governance guidance: At rollout; After rollout
claims.claim: Learn recommends managing policy actions incrementally, testing and tuning with a pilot group and simulation-mode tips before full enforcement.
claims.quote: Use three axes to control the policy deployment process: scope, state, and actions. Always take an incremental approach ... Change the state to Run the policy in simulation mode and show policy tips. Refine the scope of locations to support a pilot group if needed
